component.name: core.openwop.connections.easypost
component.description: EasyPost connection pack (RFC 0095) — api_key provider declaring the TARGET shape for the commerce shipping-rate seam (ADR 0250) as an alternative carrier to Shippo: API host, auth kind, consumer nodes. Category is `other` (openai-images precedent): the normative `category` enum has no `shipping` value and the seam would resolve by `id` (`easypost`), not category — no wire/RFC change. The rate mapper is now LIVE (ADR 0250 follow-on): with an easypost connection configured, the seam rate-shops via POST https://api.easypost.com/v2/shipments (Basic auth), converts grams+cm to EasyPost's ounces+inches, and bills the cheapest same-currency rate — as a second carrier in the shippo→easypost cascade. Rate quotes are READ calls (not money movement) — no commerce-spend gate. Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7).
